title: Ps.-Clementine Homilies (Ὁμιλίαι) / Псевдо-Климентины, «Беседы»
author: Anonymous (Ps.-Clement of Rome)
edition: B. Rehm, GCS 42 (1953; 3rd ed. 1992). Public domain: Dressel 1853; Lagarde 1865.
ru_evidence: Not on azbyka.ru (only 1 Clement and Ad virgines). The ru-wiki article 'Псевдо-Климентины' lists no translation. No dedicated Russian search was run.
en_evidence: Ante-Nicene Fathers vol. 8 (1886), Homilies and Recognitions; en-wiki notes English translations online
other_translations: French: Écrits apocryphes chrétiens II (Pléiade 2005), not re-verified
value: The only full Christian novel of family separation and recognition. Central to the history of Jewish Christianity, the Simon Magus legend, and the ancient novel.
ai_feasibility: High: plain Greek prose. Theological terminology needs consistent glossaries.
pilot_unit: Homilies XII–XIV (recognition narrative; c. 15k words est.)
